# Copilot Instructions

This repository is intended to be a SaaS product with a secure and scalable architecture.

## Workflow
- Keep changes focused and well-scoped.
- Prefer clear, production-ready code.
- Document deployment and security changes.
- Do not commit real secrets.
- Preserve developer experience and clean architecture.

## Project Notes
- Use React + TypeScript for the frontend.
- Use Node.js + Express for the backend.
- Use Prisma for database access.
- Keep environment variables in `.env.example`.
- Keep issues, docs, and deployment notes clear and structured.
